=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2667-2674 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `grep -c ... || echo 0` fallback can turn the no-match case into `0\n0`, so the first-iteration empty-output retry never fires.
  WHY: Two reviewers independently identified the same shell bug, and one confirmed the fix to `|| true` restores the intended retry behavior.
- tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py:N/A | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new `max_recoveries_by_phase` override behavior lacks explicit test coverage.
  WHY: The reviewer noted that the existing tests only cover backward compatibility, so bugs in the new phase-specific cap path would only show up when the override is non-default.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5319 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The regex `^\\[ai-autofix\\]|^\\[judge-fix\\]` relies on precedence behavior that is fragile across refactors or regex engines.
  WHY: The reviewer pointed out that the current jq/Oniguruma interpretation happens to work, but an apparently clearer rewrite or a port could change the match behavior.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:~525-535 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The audit parser depends on PCRE negative lookbehind and can silently fail in environments without `grep -P`.
  WHY: The reviewer warned that `(?<!already )` assumes PCRE support, and the `|| true` fallback would mask a grep failure by returning empty strings.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~5312, .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~1614 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `gh api --paginate | jq -s 'add // []'` can load all check-run pages into memory at once.
  WHY: The reviewer noted that a very large number of check-runs could OOM the runner and lose context for that iteration.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:2667-2674 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `grep -c ... || echo 0` fallback can turn the no-match case into `0\n0`, so the first-iteration empty-output retry never fires.
  WHY: `grep -c` prints `0` and exits 1 on no matches, so `|| echo 0` appends a second `0`; changing it to `|| true` fixes the behavior.
